verdict.rationale: Figma ships a built-in AI agent (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34) that can generate designs, diagrams, edit images, and search files, and even collaborate in FigJam (figma-docs-6), sold via AI credits (figma-docs-24). However, hands-on community feedback specifically calls the AI tools in FigJam 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), directly contradicting the polished vendor framing, while another user reports positive real-world use of the AI for summarization (figma-comm-9). missing for 10: independent benchmark of the core canvas AI agent (not just FigJam), clear reliability data, and confirmation the paid-credit gating doesn't limit 'delegate tasks' functionality.
